# VPS-Optimize vendored component

`vps-optimize.sh` is an unmodified copy of
[`Chunlion/VPS-Optimize`](https://github.com/Chunlion/VPS-Optimize) `dist/vps.sh`.
It provides the Caddy/Nginx reverse proxy, SSH security, Fail2ban, and firewall
submenus loaded by the 科技lion script.

Upstream license: GNU GPL v3. See `VPS-Optimize-LICENSE` in this directory.
The adjacent SHA-256 file is retained for runtime integrity verification.
